title: Health product access index
national_indicator_description: As noted in the [Forward Looking Joint Health Sector Review Report for Fiscal Year 2023/2024](https://www.moh.gov.rw/index.php?eID=dumpFile&t=f&f=70771&token=f73c868b77d22d7833d7762c29cde46f7ec0b4b3), this indicator is among the SDG indicators not currently monitored by the Ministry of Health. Comparable timeseries data are currently unavailable for this indicator. However, data for individual health services coverage indicators are available on the World Health Organization (WHO) [Access Indicators](https://www.who.int/tools/monitoring-and-evaluation/access-indicators) page.
indicator_definition: The health product access index is based on a series of health services coverage indicators that involve the use of any or a combination of health products for their fruition.
